Ask for access

Beethoven is on a private Chrome listing. Once you are approved, the invitation goes to this account.

By sending, you agree that the lab's own access service keeps what you send as the privacy statement says.

Install

Chrome

Private listing, by invitation: after approval you receive an invitation at the Google account you gave.

Beethoven works on one computer per approved account. It runs Claude Code and is not an Anthropic product. Agreement
